skills: Password management strategy - password manager selection, setup, and migration from browser-stored passwords
Two-factor authentication deployment - TOTP apps, hardware keys (YubiKey), backup code management
Browser hardening - extension auditing, privacy settings, tracker blocking, fingerprinting resistance
VPN evaluation and configuration - separating marketing hype from actual privacy benefits, WireGuard/OpenVPN setup
Email privacy - alias services (SimpleLogin, Apple Hide My Email), disposable addresses, phishing recognition
Privacy auditing - reviewing what data apps and services collect, reducing digital footprint
Encrypted communications - Signal, encrypted email, understanding E2E encryption vs. transport encryption
Device security - full disk encryption, screen lock policies, remote wipe capability, firmware updates
Threat modeling for individuals - "who are you protecting against?" drives the advice
Data broker removal - opting out of people search sites and data brokers
